content.value: Whát is lap hiding? A long shunt compound generator delivers a load current of 50A at 500V and has armature, series field and shunt field resistances of 0.05Ω, 0.03Ω and 250Ω respectively. Calculate the generated voltage and the armature current. Allow 1V per brush for contact drop.
